entries.note: same source as samples_ch32v003_arduino; borrowed CH32VM00X/CH32V006K8 definition with the overrides in samples_ch32v002_arduino/arduino.mk; 12-bit ADC (0..4095)
entries.criteria: uncalibrated: channel whose RC was driven high (GPIO_DRIVE 500 ms) reads >= 2800, driven low <= 1200 (0..4095, 12-bit variant); X=PA1/GP12, Y=PA2/GP13

entries.note: works by borrowing CH32VM00X/CH32V006K8 with size, _eusrstack and _heap_end overrides (no CH32V002 board definition in official 1.0.6). Size override alone: does not run (measured)
entries.criteria: same as CH32V003: boot Serial text; PC0 500/500 ms; PA1 low pauses blink

entries.note: same source as samples_ch32v003_arduino; borrowed CH32VM00X/CH32V006K8 definition with the overrides in samples_ch32v002_arduino/arduino.mk
entries.criteria: Pico I2C_SLAVE as SHT31 0x44: after reset writes 30a2 then 3041; loop writes 2400 and reads 6 bytes; 0x45 receives nothing; loop period ~5.3 s

entries.note: library 'OLED SSD1306 - SH1106' 1.0.7 pinned in sketch.yaml; relies on the Pico SSD1306 model fix of 2026-11-07 (0x21 resets only the column pointer); real OLED not used
entries.criteria: Pico SSD1306 model (0x3C): pages 0..3 and 4..7 equal the 128x32 buffer rendered on the host from the same sketch and library 1.0.7; display on, charge pump on, no bad control/overflow

entries.note: intermittent with official core 1.0.6 on both CH32V003 and CH32V002: the Wire slave stays inside the EV interrupt handler (Wire.write busy-waits for BYTE_TRANSMITTED after the master's NACK) and holds SCL low; a read followed closely by another transaction hangs. Earlier passes were runs that did not hang; non-strict xfail
entries.criteria: Pico I2C_MASTER/I2C_PROBE: 0x10 ACK, 0x11 NACK; reg 0x20 reads 00102030; write 10 aabbccdd reads back aabbccdd; read at 0x12 gives ccdd

entries.note: copied unchanged from book-code; the Pico plays the book's i2c_slave DUT; Serial output not observed
entries.criteria: Pico I2C_SLAVE 0x10: receives 10 c c+1 c+2 c+3, then 20 + 4-byte read; next loop c+1 after ~1.1 s

entries.note: sample corrected from book-code: data pin PC0 -> PC6, bytes MSB first, nop counts tuned per series (CH32V002: T0H 7, T0L 11, T1H 24, T1L 2) to the WS2812B timing centre, interrupts off while sending; byte-boundary T0L 1280 ns
entries.criteria: WS2812_CAPTURE on GP7: 18-byte frames, each one of the 6 colour rotations (MSB first), advancing one step per frame; measured High/Low widths inside WS2812B T0H 0.4 / T1H 0.8 / T0L 0.85 / T1L 0.45 us +-150 ns (byte-boundary T0L up to 1200 ns)

entries.note: same source as samples_ch32v003_arduino; borrowed CH32VM00X/CH32V006K8 definition with the overrides in samples_ch32v002_arduino/arduino.mk; PATTERN 3 remap reference xfail as on CH32V003
entries.criteria: PATTERN 2: PD2->GP14, PC4->GP15; 1 kHz (800..1200 us), duty within 15000 ppm of k/32, LED1+LED2 ~ 33/32, duty ramps. PATTERN 3 (PC6->GP7, PC5->GP6) reference xfail

entries.note: same source as samples_ch32v003_arduino; borrowed CH32VM00X/CH32V006K8 definition with the overrides in samples_ch32v002_arduino/arduino.mk
entries.criteria: Pico SPI_SLAVE mode 0: reset frame starts ffff; read frames 0000; valid reply -> next read ~1 s; reply 0000 -> CS low >= 400 ms (reset_adt7310) then reads resume

entries.note: HIL excluded: CO2 sensor over UART at 9600 baud plus SSD1306 OLED output; the Pico runs one command at a time, so a sensor reply and the OLED cannot be observed together. Compile comparison only (same on CH32V002; not built for CH32V002)
